provenance.note_two_palettes: The Master Template ships TWO palettes. Theme 1 is canonical (primary). Theme 2 is a documented secondary variant — its navy/blue are one digit off and visually imperceptible. Use Theme 1 unless you have a specific reason for Theme 2.

navy.usage: Primary dark surface — covers, chapter dividers, hero sections, table headers, dark CTA. Also primary body text on light surfaces.

navy_secondary.usage: Secondary dark surface (Master Template Theme 2). Use only when paired with Theme 2 elements.

blue.usage: Action / accent — buttons, part numbers, links, lever tags, sidebar active state.

blue_dark.usage: Hover / pressed state for blue, secondary blue for emphasis.

blue_light.usage: Soft blue background for callouts, light cards, inline highlights.

cyan.usage: Combined / total figures, bright accent on navy backgrounds.

cyan_light.usage: Soft cyan background for cards and accents.

red.usage: Semantic warning / 'from' state — current pain points, friction.

red_light.usage: Soft red background for warning callouts.

green.usage: Success / positive metrics — ROI, efficiency gains. (Not in Master Template themes — adopted from active engine for ROI sentiment.)

off_white.usage: Page background, 'from' state cards, soft surfaces.

border.usage: Card borders, table dividers, subtle separators. (Not in Master Template themes — neutral gray adopted from engine.)

text_main.usage: Primary body text on light surfaces. Same hex as navy, used for text role.

level_1_label.usage: Captions, eyebrows, tags, small annotations above titles
